candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to examine the use of a single dose of tozuleristide (24 or 36 mg) and the Canvas imaging system during surgical resection of primary central nervous system (CNS) tumors

role_evidence.quote: tozuleristide 24 or 36 mg administered intravenously 1-24 hours prior to surgery

agents.drug_class_hint: fluorescent tumour-imaging peptide-dye conjugate for intraoperative visualisation

coder_notes: Fluorescence-guided surgery imaging study across all primary CNS tumours. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords, which does not count as naming it (D27B), so coded not_glioblastoma. Tozuleristide is a diagnostic agent; Canvas system is a device.
